Luis Suárez — Senior Product Designer

Luis Suárez is a senior product designer based in Houston, Texas, with more than 20 years across UX/UI design, design systems, 3D and AR, motion design, VFX and front-end development. He leads product design at CommerceBlitz and taught design at URBE University for 12 years. His practice, Human Design, is built on three ideas: simple, approachable, emotionally connected.

Services

Product design, UX/UI design, design systems, SaaS dashboard and workflow design, brand identity systems, motion design and product video, AI-assisted design and prototyping, web design and front-end build.

Selected work

OMNI — omnichannel e-commerce and warehouse SaaS

Lead product designer, CommerceBlitz, 2024. A 0 to 1 platform replacing six browser tabs and a spreadsheet: live channel sync, order and line-level views, pick-and-pack flows and built-in onboarding, all on a token-driven design system.

EG Productions & Signs website

Creative direction and web design, 2026. A template site rebuilt around one promise, with a restructured service architecture and a single path from first look to quote request.

EG OS — internal operating system

Product designer and builder, 2026. Eleven modules on one spine — work pipeline, CRM, inventory, files, messages, calendar, reports, knowledge base — replacing seven disconnected tools for a sign and wrap company.

Logistics For Hire — brand identity system

Brand and identity design, 2022. An eleven-page brand manual: logo construction, colour values in hex and CMYK, safe margins, misuse rules, digital and print usage matrices and a partner badge programme.

Promo and product video

Motion and VFX for CommerceBlitz, GES Inc. and Jamesify, 2020 to 2023. Storyboard to edit to finished film.

Toolkit

Figma, Sketch, Principle, Miro, Hotjar, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Spline, Zappar 3D, Lottie, Rive, HTML and CSS, WordPress, Webflow, Framer, GitHub, Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Agile and Scrum.

Contact

Available for product design work and collaboration. Email suarezl@gmail.com or book a call at calendly.com/luis_suarez/60min.

AI proposes. The system disposes.

This is how I use AI on real products: generation runs wild, but my design tokens — grid, type scale, radius, contrast — decide what survives. Speed without losing the craft.

Hand this component a brief and watch it re-design itself live, with every decision logged. Same component, same system, different answers.

Runs on rules encoded from my token system — wiring it to a live model is one fetch call. The point isn't the trick; it's the constraints.
